guideline_version: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes — 2026 (Diabetes Care, Vol 49, Supplement 1, January 2026)

inputs.recency_source: Recorded patient age; treated as current.

ADA 2026 Section 6 (Glycemic Goals, Hypoglycemia, and Hyperglycemic Crises): A1C measured at least twice yearly when at goal and quarterly when not at goal.
ADA 2026 Section 11 (Chronic Kidney Disease and Risk Management): annual screening of eGFR (and UACR) in people with type 2 diabetes.
